variants.name: c-08-verification
variants.description: Deterministic validation receipt for the C-08 single markdown renderer and untrusted-HTML boundary

notes: C-08 implementation tasks 1.1 through 4.2 are complete; task 4.3 is the verification/refinement/review gate represented by this receipt.
Frontend typecheck, lint, architecture boundaries, Flat 2.0, one focused test file with fourteen tests, strict OpenSpec validation, renderer census, and diff integrity pass.
Raw HTML parsing and sanitization are present in one ordered plugin chain, with KaTeX running after the sanitizer.
The final isolated review passes at zero critical, two warnings, and zero suggestions; its actionable raw-SVG warning was resolved and deterministically revalidated.
The project has no .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md, so the C-08 OpenSpec requirements are the blocking constraint authority.
